blocks.text: Physics ki paimaishon mein precision aur accuracy ke alfaaz aksar aate hain, aur in dono ka farq saaf samajhna zaroori hai. Paimaish ki precision us instrument se tay hoti hai jis se paimaish ki gayi: least count jitna chhota, paimaish utni precise. Accuracy ka matlab hai paimaish kisi quantity ki asal (ya maani hui) qeemat ke kitni qareeb hai. Yeh fractional ya percentage uncertainty se zahir hoti hai: fractional ya percentage uncertainty jitni kam, paimaish utni accurate.
Precision: absolute uncertainty kam. Accuracy: percentage uncertainty kam.
blocks.title: Remember Thumb Rule (Yaad rakhein)

blocks.text: Misal: ek cheez ki lambai millimetre wale metre rule se 25.5 cm napi gayi. Is ki precision ya absolute uncertainty (least count) = ± 0.1 cm hai.
Ek aur paimaish 0.01 cm least count wale Vernier Callipers se li gayi aur 0.45 cm aayi. Is ki precision ya absolute uncertainty = ± 0.01 cm hai.

Kitab yahan upar (numerator) mein 0.1 cm chhapti hai. Vernier Callipers ki absolute uncertainty 0.01 cm hai, is liye sahi hisab 0.01 / 0.45 ≈ 0.02 aur 2% hai; kitab ke jawab (0.02 aur 2%) bhi isi ke mutabiq hain.
blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti

blocks.text: Yun metre rule ki reading 25.5 cm kam precise hai magar zyada accurate hai, kyunke us ki percentage uncertainty (error) kam hai.

Jabke Vernier Callipers ki reading 0.45 cm zyada precise hai magar kam accurate. Asal baat nisbati (relative) paimaish ki hai: quantity jitni chhoti ho, utna zyada precise instrument istemal karna chahiye. Yahan 0.45 cm napne ke liye aur zyada precise instrument, jaise 0.001 cm least count wala micrometer screw gauge, istemal hona chahiye tha. Is se yeh nateeja nikalta hai:
Precise paimaish woh hai jis ki absolute uncertainty kam ho, aur accurate paimaish woh hai jis ki fractional ya percentage uncertainty kam ho.
blocks.title: Precise aur accurate paimaish

blocks.text: Hum kabhi bhi bilkul exact paimaish nahi kar sakte. Zyada se zyada yeh kar sakte hain ke instrument ki had ke andar asal qeemat ke jitna ho sake qareeb pohanchein.
Hum length, time aur temperature jaisi quantities napne ke liye bohat se aalaat (devices) istemal karte hain. Har ek ki precision ki koi had hoti hai.
blocks.title: For your information

blocks.text: Yeh sajawat ke sheeshe nahi balke sab se purane maloom nafees aur hassas (sensitive) thermometers hain, jo Florence mein Accademia del Cimento (1657-1667) ne banaye. In mein alcohol bhara hota tha, jise kabhi kabhi aasani se parhne ke liye laal rang diya jata tha.
blocks.title: For your information

blocks.prompt: Ek talib-e-ilm taar ka diameter metre rule se 0.3 mm aur mez ki lambai 1 mm least count wale tape se 1.253 m napta hai. Kaun si paimaish zyada precise hai, kaun si zyada accurate, aur talib-e-ilm ko kya badalna chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Dono instruments ka least count 1 mm hai, is liye dono readings barabar precise hain. Taar ki percentage uncertainty (1/3) × 100 ≈ 33% hai, jabke mez ki (1/1253) × 100 ≈ 0.08%; is liye mez ki lambai kahin zyada accurate hai. Chhota diameter zyada precise instrument, jaise micrometer screw gauge (least count 0.01 mm), se napna chahiye.

items: Precision instrument ke least count (absolute uncertainty) se tay hoti hai; accuracy fractional ya percentage uncertainty se.
Metre rule se 25.5 cm: 0.4%, kam precise magar zyada accurate. Vernier Callipers se 0.45 cm: 2%, zyada precise magar kam accurate.
Chhoti quantity ke liye zyada precise instrument chahiye (screw gauge, 0.001 cm). Koi paimaish bilkul exact nahi hoti.
